title: Microsoft Teams: grant recording and transcript access when sharing a recap link
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, meeting-policy paths, PowerShell calls and licensing background are supported. Microsoft Support documents sharing recap access with named people in the organisation; searches did not establish a separate administrative switch, feature-specific licence or rollout default.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Teams meeting recordings and transcripts are stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.
claims.quote: When users in your organization record and transcribe Teams meetings, the recordings and transcripts are stored in either OneDrive for work or school and SharePoint.

claims.claim: Recording and accompanying transcript access normally follows OneDrive or SharePoint file permissions.
claims.quote: The captions and transcript file is stored with the video in OneDrive for Business or SharePoint. This inherits the same permissions and policy as the video file, so that whoever has access to the video file has access to the captions and transcript.

claims.claim: For non-channel meetings, invitees other than external participants automatically get a personally shared recording link.
claims.quote: For non-Channel meetings: All meeting invitees, except for external participants, automatically get a personally shared link.

claims.quote: The meeting organizer must add external participants to the shared list.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Transcription is reached through Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables meeting transcription for the specified policy.
claims.quote: To allow specific users in your organization to transcribe, run the following commands: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Meeting recording is reached through Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true enables meeting recording for the specified policy.
claims.quote: To allow specific users in your organization to record, run the following commands: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.claim: Transcription is On by default for new meeting policies.
claims.quote: Toggle Transcription On or Off. This setting is On by default for new policies.

claims.claim: Transcription is both a per-organiser and a per-user policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and note; Why it matters; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Transcription policy controls meeting transcript creation, rather than selecting recap-sharing recipients.
claims.quote: For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Why it matters; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Meeting recording policy controls whether users can record meetings, rather than selecting recording-sharing recipients.
claims.quote: -AllowCloudRecording controls whether users can record meetings; it doesn't configure or validate recording storage.

claims.claim: The policy allowing organisers to restrict copying or forwarding is per-organiser.
